heading: Local Backups
description: Create, validate, pin, and safely retain sealed recovery bundles on local storage.
invalid: {{count}} sealed artifact(s) could not be read safely.
empty: No sealed backup manifests were discovered.
recovery_normal: Validate and preflight the selected bundle with syrus-recovery before entering maintenance mode.
recovery_bootstrap: If this application or its database cannot boot, run syrus-recovery directly to inspect a mounted bundle or stream a bounded upload into an empty instance.
recovery_execution_warning: Preflight does not change installation data. Final restore remains unavailable and will require explicit confirmation, maintenance mode, and the exact preflight token.
